text: is an academician and politician who serves as the Minister of Education, Technology & Research of Sordland. She became a member of the United Sordland Party before the 1952 elections. Prior to becoming a minister, she was elected and served as an independent MP.
manual: 是一名學術家和政治家，擔任索德蘭教育、科技與研究部長。她在 1952 年選舉前成為索德蘭聯合黨成員。在成為部長之前，她被選為獨立議員並服務過。

text: In Sordland, the military operates as a conscripted force, where the duty of military service falls upon males upon reaching the age of 18. This mandatory conscription ensures a consistent and capable pool of personnel to uphold the nation's defense and security, strengthening the overall resilience and readiness of the military.
manual: 在索德蘭，軍隊作為徵兵力量運作，男性在 18 歲時有兵役義務。這項強制徵兵確保了一支持久的、有能力的人員隊伍來維護國家的防禦和安全，加強了軍隊的整體韌性和戰備狀況。

text: I declared my intention to work with the reformists for the constitutional reform.
manual: 我宣布了與改革派合作進行憲政改革的意圖。

text: We have won the 1953 election. A new chapter begins for Sordland.
manual: 我們贏得了 1953 年的選舉。索德蘭的新篇章開始了。
